supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:28 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 (10.40.20.20) connected to PROXY-NWD-01 (10.40.20.30) on port 8080, sending 640,000,221 bytes and receiving 39,190 bytes; the connection completed successfully.

A nearby connection from FILE-NWD-01 to the same proxy address and port transferred 1,220 origin bytes and 25,557 response bytes. The records do not establish that it was the same request or identify its destination URL or hostname.

The transfer size is compatible with the inventory description of approved StratoSafe offsite-backup uploads, but the available connection record does not identify the process or establish that the destination was StratoSafe.

A remote desktop connection from WS-NBLAKE-01, running under nora.blake's account, to FILE-NWD-01 began at 13:34:30 UTC and lasted about 785 seconds, overlapping the large transfer. The evidence does not link that session to the transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: Collection metadata reports that FILE-NWD-01 winsec and sysmon logs, and PROXY-NWD-01 proxy logs, were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. This overlaps the transfer and prevents process attribution and inspection of proxy request details.
Zeek connection telemetry identifies the large transfer to the proxy, but the supplied record does not identify the proxied destination, URL, or application.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer was generated by the approved StratoSafe backup agent or by another process.
Whether the proxied destination was stratosafe-backup.com or an unapproved service.
Whether the overlapping RDP session was involved in initiating or directing the transfer.
Whether the transferred data was authorized backup data or sensitive data being exfiltrated.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for the transfer, including the request hostname, URL, authenticated identity, and byte counts.
Recover FILE-NWD-01 process and security telemetry for 13:30–14:10 UTC; correlate the transfer with process execution, service activity, and the RDP session.
Check StratoSafe agent logs and job records for an upload of this size at this time, and verify the configured destination and transferred content.
unrelated_findings: Separate investigation: DC-NWD-01 recorded a service ticket request for svc-archive to FILE-NWD-01 from 139.162.174.124 at 13:43:51 UTC. The available evidence does not establish a link to the alerted transfer. [T040-00193]
